title: Put the bible in git?
question: The bible (bible/, tools/bible/, reviews/) has never been committed, so its changes (like today's story map link) can't be saved in git on their own. The repo is public on GitHub. Commit it?

options.label: Commit it to this repo
options.note: Everything in bible/ and reviews/ becomes public with the next push. Private items (rewards) are already kept out of the public build.

options.label: Commit it to a separate private repo
Leave it out of git for now
options.note: Works locally as today; nothing is versioned.

decision: Superseded by asset-storage (the bible and reviews question is section 7 of notes/asset-storage-proposal.md)
